code:
$ ls -l /usr/bin/passwd
-rwsr-xr-x 1 root root 68208 /usr/bin/passwd
$ chmod 4755 file   # same as: chmod u+s file
caption: The lowercase s replaces owner-execute — passwd runs as root, not as you.

code:
$ sudo chmod g+s invoices
$ ls -ld invoices
drwxr-s--- 2 jramirez ops 4096 invoices
caption: New files inside automatically inherit the ops group. Octal: 2770.
The trailing t means only a file's own owner can delete it, even here.

eyebrow: ACLs: one more user, no owner change
code:
$ sudo setfacl -m u:auditor:r-x invoices
$ getfacl invoices
user:auditor:r-x
caption: setfacl grants extra access; getfacl shows every ACL entry on a file.

subtitle: Permissions, users, and groups are set — next, Northbridge moves into process and service management.
